poses.name: 毒牙
poses.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one production 2D DiceLand battle action sprite that temporarily replaces the attached idle sprite. Input image 1 is the exact character and rendering reference. Match the SAME adult East Asian White Snake Demon: the same face and warm eyes, long dark brown wavy hair, pale jade flower hairpin and pendant, ivory high-neck damask hanfu with very wide sleeves, dark jade green tied obi with gold detailing, and one continuous huge tapered ivory python body with finely drawn scales and subtle warm rim light. Preserve the original painted style, realistic facial proportions, same size of head/torso relative to snake body, costume coverage and left-facing three-quarter battle view. Illustrate a genuinely new action silhouette, not the idle pose. Full-body single subject, all of hair, sleeves, coils and tail tip in frame, small clear safety margin, on genuinely transparent RGBA. Lowest solid section of the coil at the bottom, grounded, weighted and centered as in the reference so the image can be swapped in battle without jumping. Keep the main torso near the original horizontal center. Tight, complete square or near-square crop. No landscape, shadow plane, backdrop, separate snake head, second tail, human legs, target, other character, UI, words, frame or watermark. Action: VENOM FANG. A compact forward lunge aimed toward the left, head and shoulders visibly projected in front of the low anchored coil, mouth slightly open with two short sharp serpent canines and a narrowly focused gaze. The front hand reaches as a claw near the line of attack while the other sleeve is dragged backward. Add at most two tiny muted jade venom flecks close to the fangs, no beam or cloud. Tail stays low behind her so the silhouette clearly reads as a swift bite, with an especially clear face.

poses.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Correct the broken serpent anatomy in Image 1, the White Snake Demon CONSTRICT attack sprite. Image 1 is the edit target. Image 2 is the original idle sprite for identity, painted style, original ivory silk, sash, and ivory scale texture. Keep her face, olive jade flower hairpin, long dark brown waves, ivory embroidered high-neck clothes and dark green obi, left-facing angle, forward-leaning focused expression and the right palm planted on thick LOWER snake body. Keep the character on true transparent alpha.
Redraw the entire serpent body as ONE easy-to-trace unbroken taper, from waist to ONE tail tip. For the exact silhouette: directly below the centre-right obi her thick lower body descends diagonally towards the right, makes a broad easy-to-follow U-turn on the lower right, gives one thick front coil going smoothly across the bottom toward the lower left. On the LEFT END OF THE LOW GROUNDED COIL, around knee height of a human, visibly and unambiguously continue that SAME segment into the tail. This last section arches up modestly to the left and curls back inward into an open C, its thinnest pointed tip facing inward and a little down, entirely BELOW the obi line. The base of that curling section must be visible as an unbroken junction with the lower grounded coil with continuous contour, scale rows, and highlights at that junction. At no point does the curling tail touch or come from the hand, arm, sleeve, back or torso. Move the left/reaching hand and sleeve up or closer to the torso if necessary; show an unmistakable band of alpha, at least the width of a hand, between all of the curling tail and the nearest sleeve or hand. The open tail bend acts like a grounded snare; gravity still anchors the coil. Do not draw the former tall loop under the sleeve, a detached C, duplicated tail, extra snake head, detached appendage, or any ambiguous body overlaps where the tail starts.
One full-body centered hand-painted combat sprite, similar scale and ground height as the idle reference. Entire silhouette stays in frame, with a clear safety margin on the left and right. The lowest solid coil stays near 97 percent of the square canvas height so it can replace the idle sprite without a jump. No scenery, shadow plane, motion graphic, text, emblem, frame, second subject or opaque backdrop.
